name: accordion
summary: Collapsible sections built on native <details>/<summary>; a shared name makes them exclusive.
use: FAQs
Secondary settings that most people skip

avoid.case: Switching between views of equal weight

parts.description: Groups items. With a name, opening one item closes the others (native exclusive accordion).

name.description: Shared details name: only one item open at a time.

parts.description: One section: <details> with the title in its <summary>.

description.description: Optional summary of the contents or current settings, visible while closed.

rules: Titles are short and say what the section holds.

examples.title: FAQ
examples.code:
<Accordion name="faq">
  <Accordion.Item title="料金はかかりますか？">無料で始められます。</Accordion.Item>
  <Accordion.Item title="解約はいつでもできますか？">はい、いつでもできます。</Accordion.Item>
</Accordion>

name: alert-dialog
summary: A modal confirmation (role=alertdialog) that only its buttons can close.
use: Confirming something that cannot be undone

avoid.case: A form or a longer task

parts.description: A <dialog role="alertdialog" closedby="none">: Escape and clicks outside do not close it.

id.description: Required. Triggers and buttons reference it.

title.description: Required. The question, e.g. "削除しますか？".

description.description: Required. What happens, in concrete terms.

parts.description: A Button that opens it.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: The safe choice. It closes the dialog and gets focus when it opens.
The action. It closes the dialog; submit a form or add onClick to act.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus within the dialog only

rules: title and description are required.
Focus starts on the safe choice.

examples.title: Delete
examples.code:
<AlertDialog.Trigger alertDialog="delete" variant="danger">削除</AlertDialog.Trigger>
<AlertDialog id="delete" title="削除しますか？" description="タスク 5 件が消えます。取り消せません。">
  <AlertDialog.Cancel alertDialog="delete">キャンセル</AlertDialog.Cancel>
  <AlertDialog.Action alertDialog="delete">削除する</AlertDialog.Action>
</AlertDialog>

name: alert
summary: A callout in the page: a title, supporting text and an optional action, in a tone.
use: A notice that stays on the page (maintenance, a limit reached)
The result of a page-level check

avoid.case: Reporting the result of an action that just happened

parts.description: The callout. The title states the point; tone only reinforces it.

title.description: Required. One line that states the point.

action.description: Optional action, e.g. a Link or a small Button.

rules: Never rely on tone alone; the title says what happened.
Not a live region: for news that arrives later, use a toast.

examples.title: Maintenance notice
examples.code: <Alert tone="accent" title="10 月 30 日 2:00〜4:00 にメンテナンスを行います">この間は申し込みを受け付けられません。</Alert>

name: aspect-ratio
summary: A box that keeps a ratio (CSS aspect-ratio); its media fills it.
use: Thumbnails, video embeds, maps

parts.description: The box. An img, video or iframe inside fills it with object-fit: cover.

rules: The media inside still needs its own alt text or title.

examples.title: Thumbnail

name: avatar
summary: A person's picture, or their initial when there is no picture or it fails to load.
use: Who wrote, owns or is assigned something

parts.description: role=img named by `name`. The initial sits behind the picture and shows if it is missing or broken (no JavaScript).

name.description: Required. The person's name: the accessible name and the source of the initial.

status.description: Presence indicator. Include a localized statusLabel.

statusLabel.description: Accessible presence text, appended to the name.

rules: name is required; the picture itself is decorative.

examples.title: Assignee
examples.code: <Avatar name="佐藤 美咲" src="/people/sato.jpg" />

name: badge
summary: A short status or count label.
use: Status of an item (対応中, 完了)
A count next to a label

parts.description: The badge. Its text carries the meaning; tone only reinforces it.

dot.description: Shows a small status dot before the text.

rules: Never rely on tone alone; the text states the status.

examples.title: Status
examples.code: <Badge tone="danger" dot>期限切れ</Badge>

name: breadcrumb
summary: Where the page sits in the site: a nav with an ordered list of links.
use: Pages more than two levels deep

parts.description: The nav landmark and its list.

label.description: Names the nav landmark.

parts.description: One level: a link, or the current page (aria-current="page").

href.description: Link target; leave out for the current page.

rules: The last item is the current page.
Separators are drawn by CSS and not read.

examples.title: Settings
examples.code:
<Breadcrumb>
  <Breadcrumb.Item href="/">ホーム</Breadcrumb.Item>
  <Breadcrumb.Item href="/settings">設定</Breadcrumb.Item>

</Breadcrumb>

name: button-group
summary: Buttons that belong together, joined into one shape (role=group).
use: Related actions on one object
A split between an action and its menu

parts.description: role=group named by label. Inner corners and borders between the buttons are removed.

label.description: Required. Names the group.

rules: label is required: a group needs a name.

examples.title: Copy / share
examples.code: <ButtonGroup label="リンク"><Button>コピー</Button><Button>共有</Button></ButtonGroup>

name: button
summary: A native <button> that runs or confirms an action.
use: Submitting a form
Confirming a dialog
Opening a dialog or popover through `command`

avoid.case: Toggling a setting on and off

parts.description: The button itself. Defaults to type="button" so it never submits by accident.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

loading.description: While true the button reports aria-disabled, ignores activation and never submits a form.

command.description: Invoker command (HTML `command` attribute). Works without JavaScript.

commandfor.description: Id of the dialog or popover the command targets (HTML `commandfor`).

rules: An icon-only button needs aria-label.
Use at most one primary button per view.
Loading buttons stay focusable (aria-disabled), they are never natively disabled.

examples.title: Primary action
examples.code: <Button variant="primary" type="submit">Save</Button>

examples.title: Open a dialog without JavaScript
examples.code: <Button command="show-modal" commandfor="confirm">Delete</Button>

name: calendar
summary: A month of days to pick a date from, always on the page (a booking or schedule view). DatePicker uses the same calendar in its dialog.
use: Choosing a date while the month stays in view (予約日・配達日を選ぶ)

avoid.case: A date field in a form
A date the user already knows and types

parts.description: A named group with the month, its previous and next buttons, and a grid of day buttons. One day holds the Tab stop.

label.description: Required accessible name (配達日 など).

defaultFocusedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The day that first holds the Tab stop; defaults to the value, else today.

autoFocus.description: Move focus into the grid on mount, as inside a dialog.

keyboard.↑ / ↓: same day of the previous / next week
keyboard.Home / End: first / last day of the week
keyboard.PageUp / PageDown: previous / next month; with Shift, previous / next year

rules: Give a label that says what the date is for.
Show the chosen date in words next to the calendar as well; a highlighted day alone is easy to miss.

examples.title: Delivery date
examples.code: <Calendar label="配達日" defaultValue="2026-11-12" min="2026-11-05" locale="ja" />

name: card
summary: A surface that groups related content, with an optional title, description and footer.
use: A self-contained group of content or settings

avoid.case: Wrapping every block on a page (use spacing instead)

parts.description: The surface. Header and footer render only when given.

footer.description: Actions or meta at the bottom.

headingLevel.description: Keeps the page's heading outline correct.

selected.description: Selection styling. Provide a real button, checkbox or radio to change selection.

rules: Pick headingLevel so headings stay in order on the page.

examples.title: Settings card
examples.code: <Card title="通知" description="受け取る通知を選びます。" footer={<Button>保存</Button>}>…</Card>

name: carousel
summary: Slides in a horizontal scroll-snap strip; where CSS ::scroll-button and ::scroll-marker exist, the browser adds the buttons and dots.
use: A set of images or cards of equal weight that do not all fit

enhances.fallback: scroll by swipe, trackpad or the arrow keys

parts.description: A named region (aria-roledescription="カルーセル") with a focusable scroll strip.

label.description: Required. Names the carousel.

previousLabel.description: Accessible name for the previous-slide control.

nextLabel.description: Accessible name for the next-slide control.

parts.description: One slide; it is named "n / total".

keyboard.← / →: move between slides when the strip is focused; respects RTL
keyboard.Home / End: first / last slide with the runtime
keyboard.Tab: previous, numbered positions and next controls

rules: Slides never move by themselves.
The optional runtime adds controls and a current position in every supported browser; reduced motion uses immediate scrolling.

examples.title: Photos

name: checkbox
summary: A native checkbox with its own label.
use: Choosing any number of options
Confirming a single statement (agree to terms)

parts.description: A <label> around the native <input type="checkbox">. Input attributes (name, value, checked…) go to the input.

description.description: Supporting text under the label. Linked with aria-describedby when id is set.

rules: children is the label; never leave it empty.

examples.title: Agree
examples.code: <Checkbox name="terms" required>利用規約に同意します</Checkbox>

name: collapsible
summary: One section that opens and closes: a native <details>.
use: Advanced options under a form
Details most people skip

parts.description: The <details>, with the title in its <summary>.

description.description: Optional summary of the contents or current settings, visible while closed.

rules: The title says what is inside.

examples.title: Advanced
examples.code: <Collapsible title="詳細な設定">…</Collapsible>

name: combobox
summary: 検索して候補を絞り込み、1つの値を選択します。
use: 検索して候補を絞り込み、1つの値を選択します。

avoid.case: 検索や複雑な操作が不要な場合

parts.description: 検索して候補を絞り込み、1つの値を選択します。

label.description: 画面に表示するラベル。必須です。

options.description: valueは一意にします。無効な候補はキーボード移動で飛ばします。iconで装飾、keywordsで別名の検索語を追加できます。

query.description: 候補を検索する文字列。確定したvalueとは別に保持します。

onQueryChange.description: 検索語の変更を受け取ります。候補を開くときと選択時には空文字になります。非同期取得の古い応答は呼び出し側で除外します。

filter.description: manualではoptionsを再絞り込みせず表示します。サーバー側で検索・順位付けするときに指定します。確定した選択の表示は候補が入れ替わっても保持します。

loadOptions.description: 非同期で候補を取得する関数。検索語と{signal}を受け取り、候補配列を返します。開く・検索する・再試行するたびに呼ばれ、結果は再絞り込みせず表示します。閉じる・無効化・削除時に中断し、古い応答も除外します。optionsには初期選択を含めます。関数の参照変更だけでは再取得しません。データ源を切り替える場合はReactのkeyも変えます。

renderPreview.description: 候補の詳細を表示します。クリック・タップ・矢印キーではプレビューを切り替え、Enterまたは確定ボタンで選びます。プレビューには操作ボタンを含めず、重要な情報はdescriptionにも含めます。狭い画面では候補の下に表示します。

previewLabel.description: 詳細領域のアクセシブルな名前。

previewActionLabel.description: プレビュー中の候補を確定するボタンの文言。

keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: 候補を開き、選択できる項目へ移動します。取得エラー時は再試行ボタンへ移動します
keyboard.Enter: 現在の候補を選択します
keyboard.Escape: 選択済みの値を変えずに閉じます
keyboard.Tab: プレビューの詳細・確定ボタンへ順に移動します。取得エラー時は再試行へ移動します

rules: 用途が伝わるlabelを指定します。
候補・項目・行には重複しない固定のIDを指定します。
組み合わせた画面を、対象の支援技術で確認してください。

examples.title: Example
examples.code: <Combobox label="担当者" options={[{ value: "mika", label: "Mika Sato" }, { value: "kai", label: "Kai Ito" }]} />

summary: コマンドを検索し、キーボードで実行するダイアログです。
use: コマンドを検索し、キーボードで実行するダイアログです。

avoid.case: 検索や複雑な操作が不要な場合

parts.description: コマンドを検索し、キーボードで実行するダイアログです。

keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: 実行できるコマンドへ移動します
keyboard.Enter: 現在のコマンドを実行します
keyboard.Escape: 閉じて元のフォーカス位置へ戻ります
keyboard.Tab: ダイアログ内の操作へ移動します

rules: 用途が伝わるlabelを指定します。
候補・項目・行には重複しない固定のIDを指定します。
組み合わせた画面を、対象の支援技術で確認してください。

name: context-menu
summary: A menu of actions that opens where the user right-clicks an area, long-presses it on touch, or presses Shift+F10 inside it. Its items are Menu's (Menu.Item, Menu.Separator, Menu.Sub) and behave the same way.
use: Shortcuts for actions on an item in a list, a file or a canvas (名前を変更・複製・削除)

avoid.case: The only way to reach an action
Actions on a button the user clicks

parts.description: The menu popover (role=menu), placed at the pointer, or under the focused element when opened from the keyboard. It flips at the viewport edges. Put Menu.Item, Menu.Link, Menu.Separator and Menu.Sub inside.

label.description: Required accessible name of the menu.

parts.description: The region that opens the menu: right-click, a long press on touch, or Shift+F10 / the Menu key while focus is inside it. It adds no focus stop of its own; keyboard users reach it through the focusable elements it contains.

keyboard.Shift+F10 / Menu key: open the menu on its first item, under the focused element
keyboard.Letters: jump to the next item starting with them
keyboard.→ / Enter / Space on a Menu.Sub: open the submenu on its first item
keyboard.Escape: close the innermost menu and return focus to where it was

rules: A context menu is hidden: every action in it must also be reachable another way (a Menu.Trigger, a button or a shortcut).
Items are verbs (名前を変更, 複製, 削除).
Put destructive items last, after a Menu.Separator.

use: 並び替え、ページ送り、行の選択に対応したテーブルです。

label.description: テーブルの用途が伝わる名前。

locale.description: 操作ラベルはen・jaに対応。並び替えにも使います。

renderDetails.description: 行末のボタンで展開する詳細。

keyboard.Tab: 並び替え・選択・ページ送りの操作へ移動します
keyboard.Space: 行の選択を切り替えます
keyboard.Enter: 列を並び替えるか、ページを切り替えます

name: date-input
summary: A native date or time input with the browser's own picker, drawn like Input.
use: A date, time or month where typing or the system picker is enough

avoid.case: Picking from a visible calendar on the page

parts.description: <input type="date"> (or time / datetime-local / month). Put it in a Field.

rules: Label it with a Field; min and max are announced by the browser.

name: date-picker
summary: 日付を直接入力するか、カレンダーから選択します。
use: 日付を直接入力するか、カレンダーから選択します。

avoid.case: 検索や複雑な操作が不要な場合

parts.description: 日付を直接入力するか、カレンダーから選択します。

label.description: 画面に表示するラベル。必須です。

value.description: YYYY-MM-DD形式。タイムゾーン変換は行いません。

presets.description: 日付候補。valueはYYYY-MM-DD形式。範囲外は選択できません。

keyboard.Arrow keys: 左右で1日、上下で1週間移動します
keyboard.Home / End: 週の最初または最後の日へ移動します
keyboard.PageUp / PageDown: 前月・翌月へ移動します。Shiftを押すと年を切り替えます
keyboard.Escape: カレンダーを閉じ、開いたボタンへ戻ります

rules: 用途が伝わるlabelを指定します。
候補・項目・行には重複しない固定のIDを指定します。
組み合わせた画面を、対象の支援技術で確認してください。

name: dialog
summary: A modal native <dialog> that interrupts the user for a confirmation or a short task.
use: Confirming a destructive action
A short form that must be finished before continuing

avoid.case: Showing supplementary information next to a control
Reporting the result of an action

enhances.fallback: the dialog closes without an exit animation

parts.description: The <dialog> element. Opened with showModal() by a trigger's `show-modal` command.

id.description: Required. Triggers and close buttons reference it.

title.description: Required accessible title, rendered as the dialog heading.

description.description: Optional supporting text, linked with aria-describedby.

initialFocus.description: Id of the element inside the dialog to focus after opening. Requires UrushiRuntime. Use this for dynamic React content, where autoFocus alone can run before showModal().

returnFocus.description: Id of the element to focus after closing or removing an open dialog. Requires UrushiRuntime. Useful for programmatic opening and conditional rendering; native trigger restoration remains the default.

dismissible.description: any: Escape or a click outside closes it. closerequest: Escape only. none: only explicit buttons.

parts.description: A Button that opens the dialog (command="show-modal").

dialog.description: Id of the dialog to open.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: A Button that closes the dialog with a native command after the click handler. Do not disable or unmount this button in that handler: it would cancel the native default action. For a successful mutation, use a normal Button and close the dialog ref before changing state. For async work, close only after success.

dialog.description: Id of the dialog to close.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: Footer row for the dialog's buttons. Put the primary action last.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus within the dialog only

focus.initial: first focusable element, or the element with autofocus

rules: Install UrushiRuntime to restore the clicked invoker after closing on Safari too; without it, pointer focus follows browser settings.

For dynamically rendered React content, set initialFocus to an input or safe button id. React autoFocus can run before showModal(); initialFocus runs after the dialog opens. Set returnFocus to a stable trigger id when opening programmatically or unmounting the dialog.
title is required; it becomes the accessible name through aria-labelledby.
Every Dialog.Trigger and Dialog.Close must reference an existing Dialog id.
Destructive confirmations should put focus on the safe action with autofocus.

For client-side mutations, hold a ref<HTMLDialogElement> on Dialog. On success call ref.current?.close() before removing the trigger or changing state. Use Button for that action; Dialog.Close is suitable for Cancel.

examples.title: Confirm a destructive action
examples.code:
<Dialog.Trigger dialog="confirm-delete" variant="danger">Delete</Dialog.Trigger>
<Dialog id="confirm-delete" title="Delete this project?" description="This cannot be undone.">
  <Dialog.Actions>
    <Dialog.Close dialog="confirm-delete" autoFocus>Cancel</Dialog.Close>
    <Button variant="danger" type="submit" form="delete-form">Delete</Button>
  </Dialog.Actions>
</Dialog>

name: drawer
summary: A modal <dialog> that slides up from the bottom with a handle, and closes when dragged down. A bottom Sheet for phones: the runtime adds the drag; without it, Escape, the backdrop and Drawer.Close still close it.
use: A short form or a choice on a phone
Details of a list row on small screens

avoid.case: A panel beside a list on large screens

enhances.fallback: no drag; it closes with Escape, the backdrop or Drawer.Close

parts.description: The <dialog>, along the bottom edge, with a handle above the title. Drag the handle or the title down to close it.

id.description: Required. Triggers and close buttons reference it.

dismissible.description: none also turns off closing by drag.

parts.description: A Button that opens the drawer.

drawer.description: Id of the drawer to open.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: A Button that closes the drawer.

drawer.description: Id of the drawer to close.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus within the drawer only

rules: title is required.
The handle is decorative: give every drawer a visible way to close it (a Drawer.Close, or an action that closes it).
Every trigger and close button references an existing Drawer id.

examples.title: Add an event
examples.code:
<Drawer.Trigger drawer="add-event" variant="primary">予定を追加</Drawer.Trigger>
<Drawer id="add-event" title="予定を追加">
  <Field label="題名"><Input /></Field>
  <Drawer.Close drawer="add-event">やめる</Drawer.Close>
</Drawer>

name: empty
summary: What a list or page shows when there is nothing in it yet, and how to start.
use: An empty list, no search results, a first-run screen

parts.description: A centered title, explanation and action.

title.description: Required. Says what is empty, e.g. "まだタスクがありません".

description.description: Optional: why, or what to do.

action.description: Optional: the action that fills it, usually a primary Button.

rules: The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title carries the meaning.

examples.title: No tasks
examples.code: <Empty title="まだタスクがありません" description="最初のタスクを追加しましょう。" action={<Button variant="primary">タスクを追加</Button>} />

name: field
summary: Labels a single form control and links its description and error message to it.
use: Every text input, textarea and select in a form

avoid.case: A checkbox or switch (they carry their own label)

parts.description: Wraps one control (its only child) and gives it id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and required.

id.description: Required. Becomes the control's id; the label points at it.

label.description: Required visible label.

description.description: Hint shown under the label, linked with aria-describedby.

success.description: Confirmation text, hidden when error is present; linked to the control.

error.description: Error message; marks the control aria-invalid and links the message.

required.description: Marks the control required and shows a visual marker.

hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers only. Use sparingly.

rules: Every control has a visible label; hideLabel only when the context already labels it visually.
Error messages say what is wrong and how to fix it.

examples.title: Email with an error
examples.code:
<Field id="email" label="メールアドレス" error="@ を含むアドレスを入力してください。" required>
  <Input type="email" name="email" />
</Field>

name: file-input
summary: A native <input type="file">; the dropzone variant is a large target that files can be dropped on (no JavaScript).
use: Attaching files to a form

avoid.case: Uploading in the background with progress

parts.description: The file input. accept and multiple are native. Put it in a Field.

showFiles.description: With UrushiRuntime, show selected file names, sizes, image previews and individual remove buttons. Files stay local.

removeLabel.description: Accessible remove action; the file name is appended.

rules: Label it with a Field; say the accepted types in its description.

examples.title: Attachments
examples.code: <Field id="files" label="添付ファイル"><FileInput variant="dropzone" multiple /></Field>

name: hover-card
summary: A preview card for a link, shown on hover and keyboard focus (interestfor).
use: A person or page preview behind a link

parts.description: The card: an auto popover anchored to its link.
The link that shows the card on hover and focus; it still navigates when clicked.

keyboard.Tab: focusing the link shows the card

rules: Everything in the card is also reachable through the link's page.

examples.title: Person
examples.code:
<HoverCard.Trigger hoverCard="sato" href="/people/sato">佐藤 美咲</HoverCard.Trigger>
<HoverCard id="sato">…</HoverCard>

name: input-group
summary: An Input with fixed text or a button attached before or after it, drawn as one field.
use: A URL prefix (https://)
A unit (円, %)
A search field with its button

parts.description: The frame. It passes the Field's id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and required on to its Input.
Fixed text before or after the input.

rules: Put the meaning in the Field label too: addon text is not part of the input's name.

examples.title: URL
examples.code:
<Field id="site" label="サイトの URL">
  <InputGroup><InputGroup.Addon>https://</InputGroup.Addon><Input /></InputGroup>
</Field>

name: input
summary: A native single-line <input> styled by the pack.
use: Short free text, email, numbers, dates, search

parts.description: The input. All native attributes (type, name, required, pattern…) pass through.

invalid.description: Shows the error style and sets aria-invalid.

rules: Wrap in Field so it has a label.
Use the right type and autocomplete for the data.

examples.title: Email
examples.code: <Field id="email" label="メールアドレス"><Input type="email" name="email" autoComplete="email" /></Field>

name: item
summary: A row of a list: an icon, a title, a description and one action, like the rows of a settings screen. Item.Group is the list (a bordered panel with lines between the rows); a row with href is one link.
use: Settings screens
Lists of accounts, files or members with one action per row

avoid.case: Many rows to sort or filter

parts.description: One row (<li>). With href the whole row is a link and ends in a chevron; then it takes no action.

description.description: Optional supporting text: the current value or a hint.

icon.description: Optional decorative icon at the start.

action.description: Optional control at the end: a small Button, a Switch or a Badge. Not with href.

href.description: Makes the whole row a link to this URL.

parts.description: The list (<ul role=list>). outline draws the panel; plain leaves only the lines between the rows, for use inside a Card.

label.description: Accessible name of the list, when no heading names it.

rules: Put Item only inside Item.Group.
A row with href has no action: a link cannot contain another control.
A Switch in action needs its own aria-label (the row title is not its label).
The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title carries the meaning.

examples.title: Account settings
examples.code:
<Item.Group label="アカウント">
  <Item title="メールアドレス" description="hanako@example.jp" action={<Button size="sm" variant="secondary">変更</Button>} />
  <Item title="お知らせメール" description="締め切りの前日に送ります" action={<Switch aria-label="お知らせメール" defaultChecked />} />
  <Item title="パスワードと二段階認証" description="最後の変更は 3 か月前" href="/settings/security" />
</Item.Group>

name: kbd
summary: A key or keyboard shortcut, in a native <kbd>.
use: Shortcuts in help text and tooltips

parts.description: One key. Put several side by side for a combination.

pressed.description: Visual key-down state; the app owns shortcut handling.

rules: Write the key's name as text (⌘ is read as its name on most screen readers).

examples.title: Shortcut
examples.code: <Kbd>⌘</Kbd><Kbd>K</Kbd>

name: link
summary: A native <a> that navigates to another page or place.
use: Navigating to another page
Linking to an external site

avoid.case: Running an action on the current page

parts.description: The anchor. Underlined so it never relies on color alone.

variant.description: inline: inside running text. standalone: on its own line or in a list.

external.description: Opens in a new tab and says so to screen readers.

rules: Link text names the destination; never 'here' or 'more'.
External links announce that they open a new tab.

examples.title: Inline link
examples.code: 詳しくは使い方ガイドをご覧ください。

name: menu
summary: A list of actions in a popover (menu button pattern), with optional submenus. Opens without JavaScript; the runtime adds arrow keys, typeahead and submenu hover.
use: Secondary actions on an item (編集・複製・削除)

parts.description: The menu popover (role=menu).

label.description: Required accessible name of the menu.

parts.description: A Button that toggles the menu (aria-haspopup=menu).

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: An action (role=menuitem). Activating it closes the menu.

shortcut.description: Displayed hint; app registers the shortcut.

parts.description: A navigation item (role=menuitem).
A rule between groups of items.

A submenu: an item (role=menuitem, aria-haspopup=menu) that opens a nested menu of its children. On wide screens it flies out beside the item and flips at the viewport edge; on narrow screens (640px and below) the runtime opens it in place, indented under the item. Without JavaScript a click opens the flyout.

label.description: Required. The item text and the nested menu's accessible name.

keyboard.Letters: jump to the next item starting with them
keyboard.→ / Enter / Space on a Menu.Sub: open the submenu on its first item
keyboard.← in a submenu: close it and return to its item
keyboard.Escape: close the innermost menu and return focus to its trigger or item

rules: Items are verbs (編集, 複製, 削除).
Put destructive items last, after a Menu.Separator.
Nest one level of Menu.Sub at most; deeper choices belong in a dialog.

examples.title: Row actions
examples.code:
<Menu.Trigger menu="row-actions" variant="ghost" aria-label="操作">…</Menu.Trigger>
<Menu id="row-actions" label="タスクの操作">
  <Menu.Item>編集</Menu.Item>
  <Menu.Item>複製</Menu.Item>
  <Menu.Separator />
  <Menu.Item variant="danger">削除</Menu.Item>
</Menu>

examples.title: Submenu
examples.code:
<Menu id="task-actions" label="タスクの操作">
  <Menu.Item>編集する</Menu.Item>
  <Menu.Sub label="担当者を変える">
    <Menu.Item>佐藤 美咲</Menu.Item>
    <Menu.Item>鈴木 健太</Menu.Item>
  </Menu.Sub>
</Menu>

name: menubar
summary: A row of menus for an application (ファイル・編集・表示), like a desktop menu bar. Each Menubar.Menu is a trigger and its menu; the items are Menu's (Menu.Item, Menu.Separator, Menu.Sub). Opens without JavaScript; the runtime adds the menubar keyboard model and hover switching.
use: The command menus of an editor or a tool that works like a desktop application

avoid.case: A few actions on one item

enhances.fallback: each menu opens from its trigger, and Tab reaches every trigger and item

parts.description: The bar (role=menubar). With the runtime it is one Tab stop; ← → move between its menus.

label.description: Required accessible name of the bar.

parts.description: One menu of the bar: a trigger (role=menuitem, aria-haspopup=menu) and the menu it opens below. Put Menu.Item, Menu.Link, Menu.Separator and Menu.Sub inside.

label.description: Required. The trigger text and the menu's accessible name.

keyboard.← / →: move between the bar's menus; with a menu open, open the next one instead
keyboard.Home / End: first / last menu of the bar
keyboard.↓ / Enter / Space: open the menu on its first item
keyboard.↑: open the menu on its last item
keyboard.→ / ← on an item: open the next / previous menu of the bar (→ on a Menu.Sub opens the submenu)
keyboard.Escape: close the menu and return focus to its trigger

rules: Name each menu with one short noun (ファイル, 編集, 表示).
Keep the bar to the menus of one application; links between pages belong in NavigationMenu.
Show shortcuts with Menu.Item's shortcut; the app registers them.

examples.title: Editor menus
examples.code:
<Menubar label="ノートのメニュー">
  <Menubar.Menu label="ファイル">
    <Menu.Item shortcut="⌘N">新しいノート</Menu.Item>
    <Menu.Item shortcut="⌘O">開く…</Menu.Item>
  </Menubar.Menu>
  <Menubar.Menu label="編集">
    <Menu.Item shortcut="⌘Z">元に戻す</Menu.Item>
    <Menu.Item shortcut="⇧⌘Z">やり直す</Menu.Item>
  </Menubar.Menu>
</Menubar>

name: meter
summary: A measurement within a known range, in a native <meter> that colors itself by low / high / optimum.
use: Storage used, a quota, a score

avoid.case: How far a task has got

parts.description: A label, the value as text and a <meter>.

label.description: Required visible label; it names the meter.

low.description: Below this the value is low.

high.description: Above this the value is high.

optimum.description: The best value; the browser colors the bar by how far the value is from it.

valueText.description: Optional text shown for the value, e.g. "8.2 GB / 10 GB". Defaults to the percentage.

rules: label is required; it is linked with aria-labelledby.
Say the value in text too: color alone does not tell how full it is.

examples.title: Storage
examples.code: <Meter label="使用容量" value={82} high={80} optimum={0} valueText="8.2 GB / 10 GB" />

name: navigation-menu
summary: Site navigation with native disclosures, pointer-intent hover, collision-aware flyouts and responsive inline layout.
use: A website header with grouped links
Nested navigation that remains usable before JavaScript loads

avoid.case: Actions such as delete or archive

enhances.feature: Hover intent, flyouts, Escape, outside dismissal and arrow keys
enhances.fallback: Tab through links; Enter or Space toggles native summaries. Submenus stay inline without runtime or Popover API.

parts.description: Named navigation landmark. Children are Group or Link. Already renders a styled internal list and panels. Do not attach list/panel presentation classes to Root; use className only for outer width, margin, placement or position. openOnHover applies only to a mouse on a wide hover-capable screen; click and keyboard always work.

A disclosure. title is plain text, children are Link or nested Group. columns=2 lays out a wider desktop panel. Nested groups fly out with runtime, flipping at viewport edges; submenu=inline keeps them in flow. Narrow screens or insufficient side space use inline layout. No interactive content in title.
Native link, wrapped in a list item. current marks the current page.

keyboard.Tab: All visible summaries and links remain in normal DOM tab order.
keyboard.Escape: Close the nearest open group and restore its summary; dismiss pointer-opened menus even when focus is outside.
keyboard.ArrowDown / ArrowUp: Open a focused group and focus first/last entry; move within an open panel.
keyboard.ArrowLeft / ArrowRight: Move between top-level entries; when a panel is already open, switch to the focused group. Inside panels, open a child in the forward direction or close the current submenu in the backward direction, respecting RTL.
keyboard.Home / End: First/last entry in the current level.

rules: Use navigation links, not role=menu or menuitem.
Give the navigation a unique label.
Use at most one current link per navigation.
Do not put buttons, links or inputs inside Group title.
Install UrushiRuntime for hover intent, flyouts, Escape, outside dismissal and arrow keys. Basic disclosure and links need no runtime.
Hover must not move focus or hide a panel containing keyboard focus. Touch and narrow screens use explicit activation.

examples.title: Site navigation
examples.code:
<NavigationMenu label="Main navigation">
  <NavigationMenu.Group title="Product">
    <NavigationMenu.Link href="/overview" current>Overview</NavigationMenu.Link>
    <NavigationMenu.Group title="Developers">
      <NavigationMenu.Link href="/docs">Documentation</NavigationMenu.Link>
    </NavigationMenu.Group>
  </NavigationMenu.Group>
  <NavigationMenu.Link href="/pricing">Pricing</NavigationMenu.Link>
</NavigationMenu>

name: otp-input
summary: A one-time code field: one native input drawn as separate boxes, with one-time-code autofill.
use: Codes sent by mail or SMS

parts.description: A single text input (inputmode=numeric, autocomplete=one-time-code, pattern) whose background draws the boxes.

rules: It is one field, so screen readers and paste work as for any input.
Label it with a Field.

examples.title: Sign-in code
examples.code: <Field id="code" label="確認コード"><OTPInput /></Field>

name: pagination
summary: Links to the pages of a long list: previous, numbered pages with gaps, next.
use: Search results and lists split into pages

avoid.case: A feed that loads more as you scroll

parts.description: A nav of links. Each link's href comes from the template, so it works without JavaScript.

href.description: Required URL template; {page} is replaced, e.g. "/tasks?page={page}".

siblings.description: Pages shown on each side of the current one.

rules: The current page has aria-current="page"; each number says "n ページ目".

examples.title: Tasks
examples.code: <Pagination page={3} total={12} href="/tasks?page={page}" />

name: popover
summary: A non-modal panel in the top layer (native `popover`), positioned against its trigger with CSS anchor positioning.
use: Filters or settings attached to a control
Supplementary content that keeps the page usable

avoid.case: A task that must be finished before continuing

enhances.fallback: the popover closes without an exit animation

parts.description: The popover panel (role=dialog, popover=auto).

id.description: Required. Triggers and close buttons reference it.

title.description: Accessible title rendered as a heading. Provide title or aria-label.

side.description: Logical side: start/end follow the writing direction.

mode.description: auto: light dismiss (Escape / outside click) and closes other auto popovers. manual: only explicit commands.

parts.description: A Button that toggles the popover and acts as its anchor.

popover.description: Id of the popover to toggle.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: A Button that hides the popover.

popover.description: Id of the popover to hide.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

keyboard.Tab: moves from the trigger into the popover, then back to the page

focus.initial: stays on the trigger unless an element inside has autofocus
focus.restore: the trigger, when focus was inside

rules: Provide title or aria-label so the panel has an accessible name.
Every Popover.Trigger and Popover.Close must reference an existing Popover id.

examples.title: Filters next to a button
examples.code:
<Popover.Trigger popover="filters">Filters</Popover.Trigger>
<Popover id="filters" title="Filters" side="bottom" align="start">…</Popover>

name: progress
summary: How far a task has got, in a native <progress> with a visible label.
use: Uploads, imports, multi-step processes

avoid.case: A measurement within a range (disk usage, a score)

parts.description: A label and a <progress>. Without value it is indeterminate.

label.description: Required visible label; it names the progress bar.

value.description: Current amount. Leave out while the total is unknown.

milestones.description: Labelled checkpoints in the same units as value and max.

valueText.description: Readable progress, e.g. 3 of 8 files. Also announced by assistive technology.

showValue.description: Shows the percentage next to the label.

rules: label is required; it is linked with aria-labelledby.

examples.title: Upload
examples.code: <Progress label="写真をアップロード中" value={42} />

name: radio-group
summary: A <fieldset> of native radio buttons: exactly one choice, arrow keys move between them.
use: Choosing exactly one of two to six visible options

avoid.case: Many options or a long list

parts.description: The fieldset with its legend. Gives every RadioGroup.Item the group's name.

name.description: Required form field name shared by the items.

legend.description: Required visible question or label for the group.

defaultValue.description: Value of the item checked initially.

variant.description: cards gives each option a full-width selectable surface.

parts.description: One option: a <label> around a native radio input.

description.description: Supporting text under the option label.

rules: legend is required; it is the group's accessible name.

examples.title: Plan
examples.code:
<RadioGroup name="plan" legend="プラン" defaultValue="team">
  <RadioGroup.Item value="free">無料</RadioGroup.Item>
  <RadioGroup.Item value="team" description="5 人まで">チーム</RadioGroup.Item>
</RadioGroup>

name: resizable
summary: Two panes split by a handle that changes their sizes, like a mail list beside the message. Drag the handle, or focus it and use the arrow keys (WAI-ARIA window splitter). Without the runtime the split stays at defaultSize.
use: A list beside its details in an application
An editor beside its preview

avoid.case: A page layout that should follow the screen size
Showing or hiding a side panel

enhances.fallback: the panes keep their default sizes

parts.description: The split: Resizable.Panel, Resizable.Handle, Resizable.Panel, in that order. Give it a height (or a parent that sets one) for a vertical split.

orientation.description: horizontal puts the panes side by side; vertical stacks them.

defaultSize.description: The first pane's share, in percent.

min.description: The smallest share of the first pane, in percent.

max.description: The largest share of the first pane, in percent.

parts.description: One pane. It scrolls when its content does not fit.
The handle between the panes (role=separator, focusable). A thin line that thickens on hover and focus; grip adds a visible grip.

label.description: Required. What the handle resizes, e.g. "一覧の幅".

grip.description: Show a grip in the middle, so it is visibly draggable.

keyboard.← → (horizontal) / ↑ ↓ (vertical): move the handle by 2%; with Shift by 10%
keyboard.Home / End: to the smallest or largest share

rules: label is required; it names the handle.
Put exactly two Resizable.Panel and one Resizable.Handle between them.
Keep min large enough that the first pane stays usable.

examples.title: Mail list and message
examples.code:
<Resizable defaultSize={35} min={25} max={60}>
  <Resizable.Panel>…一覧…</Resizable.Panel>
  <Resizable.Handle label="一覧の幅" />
  <Resizable.Panel>…本文…</Resizable.Panel>
</Resizable>

name: scroll-area
summary: A scrolling region with pack-styled scrollbars, focusable and named so keyboards can scroll it.
use: A long list inside a fixed-height panel
Wide content that scrolls sideways

parts.description: role=region with a name and tabIndex=0. Set its height (or width) from the outside.

label.description: Required. Names the region for screen readers.

rules: label is required: a focusable region needs a name.

examples.title: Members
examples.code: <ScrollArea label="参加者" style={{ blockSize: 240 }}>…</ScrollArea>

name: select
summary: A native <select>; with appearance: base-select its picker follows the pack.
use: Choosing one option from a list of about 5 to 15

parts.description: The select. Children are native <option> and <optgroup> elements.

placeholder.description: Adds a disabled first option shown until a choice is made.

rules: Wrap in Field so it has a label.

examples.title: Assignee
examples.code: <Field id="owner" label="担当"><Select name="owner" placeholder="選択してください"><option>山田</option><option>佐藤</option></Select></Field>

name: separator
summary: A thin rule between groups of content.
use: Separating groups when spacing alone is not enough

parts.description: <hr> (horizontal) or a vertical separator.

decorative.description: Hide from assistive technology when it only decorates.

rules: Use decorative when the rule adds no structure.

examples.title: Between groups
examples.code: <Separator />

name: sheet
summary: A modal <dialog> that slides in from an edge of the screen.
use: Details or a form next to a list
Navigation or filters on small screens

parts.description: The <dialog>, pinned to one edge.

id.description: Required. Triggers and close buttons reference it.

side.description: The edge it slides from (start/end follow the writing direction).

parts.description: A Button that opens the sheet.

sheet.description: Id of the sheet to open.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

parts.description: A Button that closes the sheet.

sheet.description: Id of the sheet to close.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

keyboard.Tab: moves focus within the sheet only

rules: title is required.
Every trigger and close button references an existing Sheet id.

examples.title: Task details
examples.code:
<Sheet.Trigger sheet="task">詳細</Sheet.Trigger>
<Sheet id="task" title="告知メールの文面を確定する">…</Sheet>

name: sidebar
summary: An app's side navigation: groups of links, optionally collapsible with native <details>.
use: The main navigation of an app with many sections

avoid.case: A short list of top-level pages

parts.description: The nav landmark.

label.description: Required. Names the nav landmark.

parts.description: A titled group of items. collapsible makes it a <details>.
A link. The current page gets aria-current="page".

rules: Exactly one item is current per page.
Icons are decorative; the text names the link.

examples.title: App
examples.code:
<Sidebar label="メイン">
  <Sidebar.Group title="プロジェクト">
    <Sidebar.Item href="/tasks" current>タスク</Sidebar.Item>
    <Sidebar.Item href="/members">メンバー</Sidebar.Item>
  </Sidebar.Group>
</Sidebar>

name: skeleton
summary: A placeholder shape shown while content loads.
use: Reserving the space of content that is still loading

parts.description: The placeholder. Hidden from assistive technology; announce loading elsewhere (aria-busy on the region).

lines.description: Number of text lines when shape is text.

rules: Set aria-busy="true" on the region that is loading.

examples.title: Text lines
examples.code: <Skeleton shape="text" lines={3} />

name: slider
summary: A native range input with optional live value feedback and directly selectable labelled marks.
use: An approximate value where the exact number matters less (音量, 明るさ)

parts.description: The range input. Put it in a Field for its label; min, max, step and value are native.

showValue.description: Shows a value bubble following the thumb. Requires UrushiRuntime for live feedback; the range itself works without JavaScript.

valueSuffix.description: Visible unit appended to the value, such as % or px. Use aria-valuetext for a spoken custom unit.

marks.description: Positions with {value,label?}. UrushiRuntime makes them selectable and sends native input/change events, including to React onChange. Keep labels short and sparse.

rules: Label it with a Field.

examples.title: Volume
examples.code: <Field id="volume" label="音量"><Slider min={0} max={100} defaultValue={60} /></Field>

name: spinner
summary: An indeterminate progress indicator with a status message for screen readers.
use: Short waits where the remaining time is unknown

avoid.case: Loading a layout you can predict

parts.description: role="status" with a visually hidden label.

label.description: Announced to screen readers.

showLabel.description: Also display the status label next to the ring.

rules: label says what is loading when it is not obvious.

examples.title: Loading
examples.code: <Spinner label="検索結果を読み込み中" />

name: steps
summary: Where the user is in a fixed sequence: an ordered list with aria-current="step".
use: Sign-up or checkout steps
A setup checklist

parts.description: The ordered list.

label.description: Required. Names the sequence, e.g. "申し込みの手順".

parts.description: One step. The current one gets aria-current="step"; each says its state in hidden text.

rules: Exactly one step is current.
State is spoken (完了 / 現在の手順), not only shown by color.

examples.title: Sign-up
examples.code:
<Steps label="申し込みの手順">
  <Steps.Item title="アカウント" status="done" />
  <Steps.Item title="お支払い" status="current" />
  <Steps.Item title="確認" />
</Steps>

name: switch
summary: A native checkbox with role="switch" for settings that take effect immediately.
use: Turning a setting on or off right away

avoid.case: A choice that is submitted with a form

parts.description: A <label> around <input type="checkbox" role="switch">.

showState.description: Adds on/off marks to the track so its state is also visible without relying on color.

rules: The label names the setting, not its state ('通知', not '通知をオンにする').

examples.title: Notifications
examples.code: <Switch name="notify" defaultChecked>メール通知</Switch>

name: table
summary: A native <table> styled by the pack. You write thead, tbody, th and td as usual.
use: Comparing items across the same columns
Lists with several attributes per row

parts.description: The table inside a horizontally scrolling wrapper. Children are native thead / tbody / tr / th / td.

caption.description: Required. Names the table; hide it visually with hideCaption.

rules: caption is required: it is the table's accessible name.
Use th with scope="col" / scope="row" for headers.

examples.title: Tasks
examples.code:
タスク期限
告知メールの文面を確定する10/24

name: tabs
summary: Switches between panels of equal weight. Server-rendered; the runtime adds clicking and arrow keys.
use: Views of the same object (概要・設定・履歴)

enhances.fallback: only the default panel is reachable

parts.description: The root. Generates the ids that link tabs and panels.

id.description: Required. Prefix for the tab and panel ids.

label.description: Required accessible name of the tab list.

defaultValue.description: Required value of the tab selected initially.

motion.description: Moves the selected indicator and interpolates panel height without scaling text. Respects reduced motion; none switches immediately.

parts.description: role=tablist; holds the Tabs.Tab elements.
role=tab.

A button outside the tab list that selects a panel by Tabs id and value. The runtime keeps it in sync with pointer and keyboard selection; no DOM query or React selection state is needed. It does not move focus into the tab list; keyboard focus remains on the activating button. Disabled targets are not activated.

tabs.description: Id of the Tabs root to control.

value.description: Value of the Tabs.Tab to select.

parts.description: role=tabpanel.

keyboard.← / →: move to and select the previous / next tab

rules: Tabs.Tab and Tabs.Panel must be direct children of Tabs.List and Tabs.

examples.title: Select a view from outside the tab list
examples.code:
<Tabs.Activate tabs="project" value="settings">設定を開く</Tabs.Activate>
<Tabs id="project" label="プロジェクト" defaultValue="overview">
  <Tabs.List><Tabs.Tab value="overview">概要</Tabs.Tab><Tabs.Tab value="settings">設定</Tabs.Tab></Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panel value="overview">…</Tabs.Panel><Tabs.Panel value="settings">…</Tabs.Panel>
</Tabs>

examples.title: Project views
examples.code:
<Tabs id="project" label="プロジェクト" defaultValue="overview">
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Tab value="overview">概要</Tabs.Tab>
    <Tabs.Tab value="settings">設定</Tabs.Tab>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panel value="overview">…</Tabs.Panel>
  <Tabs.Panel value="settings">…</Tabs.Panel>
</Tabs>

name: textarea
summary: A native <textarea> that grows with its content (field-sizing).
use: Comments, descriptions and other multi-line text

parts.description: The textarea. All native attributes pass through.

autoResize.description: Grow with the content up to 12 lines.

showCount.description: Show a live length and optional maxLength budget with UrushiRuntime. Uses native UTF-16 length.

rules: Wrap in Field so it has a label.

examples.title: Comment
examples.code: <Field id="comment" label="コメント"><Textarea name="comment" rows={4} /></Field>

name: toast
summary: Brief notifications about the result of an action. Place one <Toaster /> per page and call toast() from client code.
use: Confirming that an action finished (保存しました)
Reporting a recoverable failure

parts.description: The live region toasts appear in. A manual popover so it stays above modal dialogs.

label.description: Accessible name of the region.

rules: Messages are short and name the result in the same words as the action (保存 → 保存しました).
Toasts are announced politely; never put the only copy of important information in one.

examples.title: After saving
examples.code: toast("保存しました", { tone: "ok" })

examples.title: Follow an async operation
Update progress in place

name: toggle-group
summary: A segmented control: native radios (one choice) or checkboxes (several) drawn as one row of buttons.
use: Choosing a view (リスト / ボード)
Text alignment in a toolbar

parts.description: A fieldset; items get its name and type.

hideLegend.description: Keeps the legend for screen readers only.

name.description: Required form name shared by the items.

parts.description: One segment: a radio or checkbox inside a <label>.

rules: legend is required even when hidden.
Icon-only items need aria-label.

examples.title: View
examples.code:
<ToggleGroup legend="表示" name="view" defaultValue="list">
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="list">リスト</ToggleGroup.Item>
  <ToggleGroup.Item value="board">ボード</ToggleGroup.Item>
</ToggleGroup>

name: toggle
summary: A button-looking on/off control. It is a native checkbox, so it works in forms and without JavaScript.
use: Formatting in a toolbar (太字)
Showing or hiding something in place

avoid.case: A setting that applies at once in a list of settings

parts.description: A <label> drawn as a button around a checkbox. Other props go to the checkbox.

rules: Icon-only toggles need aria-label.
It is exposed as a checkbox (checked / not checked).

examples.title: Bold
examples.code: <Toggle aria-label="太字"><BoldIcon /></Toggle>

name: tooltip
summary: A short description shown on hover and keyboard focus: popover="hint" opened through interestfor.
use: Naming or describing an icon button
A keyboard shortcut hint

parts.description: The tooltip (role=tooltip, popover=hint).
A Button that shows the tooltip on hover and focus and is described by it.

variant.description: primary is the single main action of a view. danger is for destructive actions.

size.description: Control height. Density comes from the pack, not from this prop.

rules: The trigger still needs its own name (aria-label for icon buttons); the tooltip only describes it.
Never put links or buttons in a tooltip.

examples.title: Icon button
examples.code:
<Tooltip.Trigger tooltip="tip-copy" aria-label="コピー" variant="ghost">⧉</Tooltip.Trigger>
<Tooltip id="tip-copy">クリップボードにコピー（⌘C）</Tooltip>
